title: ZX Bank Branch Network in Nepal

nodes.title: Province No. 1
nodes.summary: Four Province No. 1 branches in Biratnagar-9, Birtamode (Mechi Highway), Damak (Jhapa) and Itahari (Sunsari), with IFSC codes ZXIN0001001 to ZXIN0001004.

nodes.title: Madhesh Province
nodes.summary: Four Madhesh branches in Janakpur (Janakpur Road), Birgunj Metropolitan, Gaur Chowk (Rautahat) and Malangwa (Sarlahi), with IFSC codes ZXIN0002001 to ZXIN0002004.

nodes.title: Bagmati Province
nodes.summary: Four Bagmati branches in Kathmandu (New Road), Lalitpur (Lagankhel), Banepa (Kavre) and Hetauda (Makwanpur), with IFSC codes ZXIN0003001 to ZXIN0003004.

nodes.title: Gandaki Province
nodes.summary: Four Gandaki branches in Pokhara (Chipledhunga and Prithvi Chowk), Baglung and Lamjung (Besisahar Road), with IFSC codes ZXIN0004001 to ZXIN0004004.

nodes.title: Lumbini Province
nodes.summary: Four Lumbini branches in Butwal (Traffic Chowk), Kohalpur (Nepalgunj Road), Bhairahawa (Siddharthanagar) and Dang (Ghorahi), with IFSC codes ZXIN0005001 to ZXIN0005004.
